name: zutil_zbd_section_handler_invoke_pre_load
description: zZbdSectionHandler::InvokePreLoad returns success for a missing pre-load callback, otherwise dispatches the registered fastcall callback with callback context and user data.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD/ZAR manager helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c06a0 validates the nullable onPreLoad load from this+0x4, default return value 1, userData load from this+0x10, and fastcall dispatch with callbackCtx in ECX and userData in EDX.
The native smoke verifies the null-callback success path and that a registered callback receives the exact context and user-data pointer while forwarding the callback return value.
